author: architect (WO-100)
note: Task awareness (WO-100): conversations run against one seeded SYNTHETIC person (world below) through agent-chat's dispatch (evals/career/world.ts), graded by the same judge as conversations.json. A turn may name a thread: a new thread starts empty, as a new conversation does. 'items' are C27-C41 (the audit's T01-T15); 'heldout' are paraphrases of the same asks, written apart from the code, which must never contain their text. Run: deno run -A evals/career/run-conversations.ts --set in-flight --brain agent|router --label <label> (needs OPENAI_API_KEY; NOT RUN without it). The bar (the order): >= 13/15 items and >= 90% held-out with the agent brain.
